description: Standing query, zero results expected: no S3 request from a network address in the last three days without TLS 1.2 or 1.3. Requests AWS makes internally carry no TLS details and come from a service name, so they are not judged. Covers events normalized since 2026-10-02 23:06 UTC, when the normalizer began keeping TLS

params.query: SELECT dt, actor.user.name AS actor, api.operation AS operation, tls.version AS tls, count(*) AS requests FROM normalized_events WHERE source='aws' AND dt >= date_format(date_add('day', -2, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AND api.service.name = 's3.amazonaws.com' AND regexp_like(coalesce(src_endpoint.ip, ''), '^[0-9a-fA-F.:]+$') AND tls IS NOT NULL AND (tls.version IS NULL OR tls.version NOT IN ('TLSv1.2','TLSv1.3')) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 LIMIT 50

matrix_rows.gap: S3 requests CloudTrail records: management events for every bucket, object requests for the extract bucket only, since data events are scoped to customer data. No server access logs. GCS is not in the corpus.
